structuredPolicy.householdDefinition: All persons living in the household who are financially interdependent, including the patient, spouse, and dependents claimed on a federal tax return.

discountedCareRules.customDescription: Discounted care for households from 151% through 200% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines. This demonstration policy is constructed so the published example (charges $18,420, household of 3, income $51,000) yields $15,950 in assistance and a $2,470 remainder.

residency.description: This demonstration policy does not impose a state-residency test.

assets.description: This demonstration policy does not apply an asset test.

requiredDocuments.description: Recent proof of household income (pay stubs, benefit letter, or tax return).
Completed Example Medical Center Financial Assistance Application.
Copy of the billing statement being reviewed.

structuredPolicy.collectionsSummary: Example Medical Center describes reasonable efforts to determine FAP eligibility before certain extraordinary collection actions, consistent with the federal 120-day notification period and 240-day application period framework for applicable nonprofit hospitals. This is a demonstration policy, not legal advice.
notes: Fictional demonstration policy. Do not treat this as a real hospital Financial Assistance Policy.
Insured patients are eligible under this demonstration policy.

citations.shortExcerpt: Households at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines may receive free care for eligible services.
Households from 151% through 400% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines may receive discounted care on a sliding scale.
Insured and uninsured patients may apply for financial assistance for eligible medically necessary and emergency services.
Applicants should provide proof of income, household size, and the bill under review.
Submit the Financial Assistance Application by mail, in person, or through the hospital's application page.
